_note: GAME-07, LVL-02a. Generic pickup kinds. health: this kind. shift: metres the blob hops out with. Distances in metres, times in seconds.

health._note: A finisher sprays count blobs of amount health each. They hop out, settle, and bob. collectRadius: collected within this of the feet. attractRadius: closer than this (and the player not full health) they drift to the player at attractSpeed. max: live blobs across the whole level, the oldest first. lifetime: seconds before a blob dissolves.

healthPack._note: HP-01. The health pack a level file places (a pickups entry of type health, with its own amount). A cream box, bigger than a finisher blob, that sits on the floor (no hop), turns slowly and bobs like the ammo box, never expires and never drifts to the player. Walked within collectRadius of it, it heals the entry's amount (capped at the player's maximum) and is gone; at full health it stays. size: the box edge in metres. turnRate: radians per second.

ammo._note: LVL-02a. The foam ammo box the level files place (a pickups entry of a darts-* type). It sits on the floor (no hop), turns slowly and bobs, size is the box edge in metres, and a player within collectRadius of it collects it. The dart count comes from the level file's count field. lifetime 0: level boxes never expire. turnRate: radians per second.

blaster._note: LVL-05. The blaster a level gives away (a pickups entry of type blaster with its blaster id). It shows that blaster's own model at world size, floating at its rest height, turning slowly and bobbing like the ammo box, and is taken by walking within collectRadius of it. foot: metres the model's origin rests above the floor (the ball it stands on, as the ammo box's half edge is). turnRate: radians per second.
